   d) One volunteer from the Odisha Disaster Rapid Action Force (ODRAF), wherever available.

   a) Maintaining the shelter register and updating the daily attendance of evacuated families.
   b) Ensuring adequate stock of dry food, drinking water, and first-aid materials.
   c) Coordinating with the nearest police station for security of the shelter premises.
   d) Reporting any damage to the shelter building to the Block Development Officer within 24 hours.

Sir/Madam,

In continuation of the shelter registry circular issued vide No. SRC/OSDMA/CYC-04/2023/1152 dated 10.05.2023 and the facility audit communication dated 11.05.2023, the following additional instructions are issued for uniform implementation across all notified shelters. These instructions shall remain in force until further orders and shall be read together with the Standard Operating Procedure for Cyclone Shelter Management, 2022 edition.

1. Shelter Activation Levels

All shelters listed in the master registry are to be brought to "Ready" status with effect from 14.05.2023, 0600 hrs. "Ready" status implies the following:

a. The shelter in-charge has physically verified the premises and submitted the readiness checklist to the concerned Block Development Officer (BDO).  
b. All toilets have been cleaned and water storage tanks filled to capacity.  
c. The generator, where provided, has been test-run for at least 15 minutes and the fuel log updated.  
d. The first-aid box has been checked and the expiry date of all medicines noted in the register. Expired items are to be replaced by the PHC before 14.05.2023 evening.  
e. The list of vulnerable families (elderly, disabled, pregnant women, and unaccompanied minors) has been updated at the panchayat level and a copy kept at the shelter.

Shelters shall be raised to "Active" status only upon specific direction from the District Emergency Operations Centre (DEOC). No shelter shall be opened for general public entry prior to such direction, except for pre-identified vulnerable persons who may be admitted on the written order of the Block Development Officer.

2. Evacuee Registration and Entry Protocol

Each shelter shall maintain a single entry register in the format prescribed by the DEOC. The register shall record:

a. Name, age, sex, and village/ward of the evacuee.  
b. Number of family members accompanying.  
c. Time of entry and time of exit (for those who leave temporarily).  
d. Any medical complaint noted at the time of entry.

The in-charge shall issue a simple token (paper slip) to the head of each family indicating the family serial number. This token will be used for food distribution and for locating the family in case of emergency. Tokens shall be colour-coded by block to avoid confusion when shelters receive evacuees from multiple blocks.

No evacuee shall be turned away on the ground of being from a different district. In such cases, the shelter in-charge shall note the details in the register and inform the DEOC within two hours. The DEOC will coordinate with the neighbouring district control room for data sharing.

3. Provisions for Persons with Disabilities and Special Needs

The following arrangements shall be ensured at every shelter:

a. The toilet designed for persons with disabilities shall be kept unlocked and free of storage material at all times.  
b. A ramp (where available) shall be checked for obstruction. Where no ramp exists, the in-charge shall make arrangements with the local PRI for a temporary wooden ramp.  
c. Volunteers trained in sign language and basic disability support shall be deployed at shelters with capacity of 200 or more. The list of such volunteers is available with the Block Office.

Shelter registration procedure: Any new shelter, including school buildings, community halls, or private buildings offered for use, must be registered with the district authority before being included in the evacuation plan. The registration form (Annexure-III) shall be submitted in duplicate to the District Emergency Officer. No shelter shall be used for evacuation purposes unless its registration number is communicated to the SEOC.

5. The Shelter Management Committee shall comprise the following:

   d) One volunteer from the Odisha Disaster Rapid Action Force (ODRAF), wherever available.

6. The Shelter Manager shall be responsible for:
   a) Maintaining the shelter register and updating the daily attendance of evacuated families.
   b) Ensuring adequate stock of dry food, drinking water, and first-aid materials.
   c) Coordinating with the nearest police station for security of the shelter premises.
   d) Reporting any damage to the shelter building to the Block Development Officer within 24 hours.

7. All district authorities shall submit the updated shelter list to the SEOC by 13 May 2023, 1700 hours. The list shall include the shelter code, location (village/ward), capacity in beds, and the name and contact number of the Shelter Manager.

Sir/Madam,

In continuation of the shelter registry circular issued vide No. SRC/OSDMA/CYC-04/2023/1152 dated 10.05.2023 and the facility audit communication dated 11.05.2023, the following additional instructions are issued for uniform implementation across all notified shelters. These instructions shall remain in force until further orders and shall be read together with the Standard Operating Procedure for Cyclone Shelter Management, 2022 edition.

1. Shelter Activation Levels

All shelters listed in the master registry are to be brought to "Ready" status with effect from 14.05.2023, 0600 hrs. "Ready" status implies the following:

a. The shelter in-charge has physically verified the premises and submitted the readiness checklist to the concerned Block Development Officer (BDO).  
b. All toilets have been cleaned and water storage tanks filled to capacity.  
c. The generator, where provided, has been test-run for at least 15 minutes and the fuel log updated.  
d. The first-aid box has been checked and the expiry date of all medicines noted in the register. Expired items are to be replaced by the PHC before 14.05.2023 evening.  
e. The list of vulnerable families (elderly, disabled, pregnant women, and unaccompanied minors) has been updated at the panchayat level and a copy kept at the shelter.

Shelters shall be raised to "Active" status only upon specific direction from the District Emergency Operations Centre (DEOC). No shelter shall be opened for general public entry prior to such direction, except for pre-identified vulnerable persons who may be admitted on the written order of the Block Development Officer.

2. Evacuee Registration and Entry Protocol

Each shelter shall maintain a single entry register in the format prescribed by the DEOC. The register shall record:

a. Name, age, sex, and village/ward of the evacuee.  
b. Number of family members accompanying.  
c. Time of entry and time of exit (for those who leave temporarily).  
d. Any medical complaint noted at the time of entry.

The in-charge shall issue a simple token (paper slip) to the head of each family indicating the family serial number. This token will be used for food distribution and for locating the family in case of emergency. Tokens shall be colour-coded by block to avoid confusion when shelters receive evacuees from multiple blocks.

No evacuee shall be turned away on the ground of being from a different district. In such cases, the shelter in-charge shall note the details in the register and inform the DEOC within two hours. The DEOC will coordinate with the neighbouring district control room for data sharing.

3. Provisions for Persons with Disabilities and Special Needs

The following arrangements shall be ensured at every shelter:

a. The toilet designed for persons with disabilities shall be kept unlocked and free of storage material at all times.  
b. A ramp (where available) shall be checked for obstruction. Where no ramp exists, the in-charge shall make arrangements with the local PRI for a temporary wooden ramp.  
c. Volunteers trained in sign language and basic disability support shall be deployed at shelters with capacity of 200 or more. The list of such volunteers is available with the Block Office.
